text:
kai: quick flag  onboarding raven13b-int4 on staging shows a small uptick in hallucination for RAG-summary tasks when context mixes short trusted docs + long noisy docs. want to create a focused mini-golden for hallucination detection and run a tight relabel/dedupe before any wider rollout.
sara: can you share the initial signal? skim numbers would help.
kai: ran 400 RAG sessions (mix of multi-doc concat). early diffs:
```
metric               fp16    int4    delta
----------------------------------------
halluc_rate@10       0.038   0.072   +0.034
precision_cite       0.882   0.843   -0.039
long_recall@20       0.815   0.802   -0.013
latency(ms)          290     200    -90
```
kai: halluc_rate almost doubled on noisy-doc mixes, precision of citations drops. cost/latency wins are solid but we need to triage content safety and citation accuracy.
micah: ok this is mainly curation + eval. proposal: 1) assemble 240-item mini-golden targeted at hallucination patterns (inventions, wrong-citation, hallucinated facts) 2) dedupe with paraphrase+embed-sim then manual triage 3) 3-way golden consensus where labelers mark HALLU_TYPE (INVENT, WRONG_CITE, CONTRADICT) and provide supporting evidence line numbers.
sara: add a 50-item fast-lane of high-risk customer repro prompts (RAG merges, policy docs). also include synthetic adversarial docs that try to lure model to invent facts.
labeler-bot: created task ML-GOLD-1812346 for "raven13b-int4 hallucination mini-golden". 240 items assigned; fast-lane 50 flagged. ETA 42h. :robot_face:
infra: staging has capacity for the runs; if you want side-by-side tokenizers use `--tokenizer=canonical:v2` flag. set autoscale to profile-run if heavy parallelism needed.
micah: dedupe plan: run `tools/dedupe_paraphrase_v3.sh --embed-thresh 0.88 --fuzzy 0.75` then token-aware pass for citation offsets. collisions sent to manual triage.
sara: label instructions: primary = hallucination presence (binary), secondary = hallucination type tag, tertiary = citation precision (0-3). require a short evidence snippet and line pointer. tag `MAYBE_HALLU` when unsure. use rubric: https://confluence.redwood.ai/curation/hallu-rubric.
kai: kicking dedupe now. also instrument eval harness to compute per-type halluc_rate and citation_precision. run: `eval/harness/rag_hallu_compare.py --models raven13b-fp16,raven13b-int4 --subset mini-hallu`
labeler-bot: dedupe started (job 1812346-dedupe). estimated collisions: ~19%. progress updates in thread.
micah: after relabel, we'll run a targeted prompt scaffold A ("cite the source sentence and line number") on a 60-item probe to see if prompt engineering can reduce hallucination without model change. if that works, we might avoid more relabeling.
labeler-bot: relabel kickoff: ML-GOLD-1812346-labeling in progress. 240 -> expected consensus ~220.
labeler-bot: relabel complete. 240 -> consensus 227 items (13 abstains). fast-lane 50 -> consensus 48 (2 abstains). artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/raven13b-hallu/1812346/results.json
kai: running eval now on consensus set. first pass:
```
metric               fp16    int4    delta
----------------------------------------
halluc_rate@10       0.039   0.061   +0.022
precision_cite       0.879   0.852   -0.027
long_recall@20       0.812   0.807   -0.005
```
kai: still an increase in hallucination but improved vs raw canary. next step: try the prompt scaffold A on the 60 probes. if that closes gap, we can deploy with scaffold.
micah: labelers available to QA 60 probes in ~8h. do it.
labeler-bot: added 60 probes to ML-GOLD-1812346-probe. 12 labelers assigned. ETA 8h.
sara: reminder for labelers: when tagging WRONG_CITE include the model-provided citation and the actual matched source or mark as NONE if fabricated. we need traceability.
kai: probe scaffold applied and re-eval on 60: halluc_rate@10 on probe = 0.042 (was 0.073), precision_cite delta now -0.008. big win.
micah: that suggests prompt mitigation is effective for these patterns. recommendation: proceed to limited dedicated canary with prompt scaffold deployed and monitoring for halluc_rate and precision_cite. set rollout gate: hold if halluc_rate > 1.5% absolute or precision_cite drop > 2.5% vs fp16 on rolling 1h window.
sara: i'll update golden registry entry `raven13b-int4-hallu-mini-20250220` and attach S3 consensus + dedupe traces.
labeler-bot: ML-GOLD-1812346 archived. artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/raven13b-hallu/1812346/ (results, collisions, audit-traces). :file_folder:
leah: filing rollout ticket RW-1812346 with owners: kai (owner), micah (metrics), sara (curation), infra (ops). scheduling 48h limited canary with dashboards for halluc_rate, precision_cite, ENTITY_FLIP.
kai: thanks all. will post canary checklist and monitor. :thumbsup:
